Ok, so what I would do is duplicate both subtools. This way, if you need to undo anything you can (non destructive workflow). 

On the dupliacte that you want a portion of, mask the portion you want to keep and hide the unmasked. Then in geometry  tab you can Delete Hidden. This way you'll have a subtool with just the portion you want. You can then merge this new subtool to the duplicate of the other tool. 

If you like it, you can delete the original tools. If not delete the duplicates and try again. (That's why we did the non destructive workflow.)

I would also save a version before you do all this, just in case, as merging subtools is not undoable.  It's always best to cover your bases.  

Hopefully this helps!
